goal: To create an AI tutor system that adjusts question difficulty based on detected student frustration levels.
core_capabilities: Assess student frustration during learning sessions.
Adapt question difficulty dynamically based on student frustration.
main_components: Frustration Assessment Module: This component identifies student frustration levels.
Question Difficulty Adjustment Engine: This component adjusts the difficulty of questions presented to the student based on their current frustration level.
Learning Management Interface: This component facilitates interaction with the student and presents questions accordingly.
assumptions: The system can infer student frustration through some measurable indicators.
open_questions: What measurable indicators will the system use to assess student frustration?
